verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing directly claims month-end close automation. It offers one-click accrual booking for incomplete expenses to "close the books every day" and automated GL coding by entity, and positions this within AI-powered financial operations alongside AI-powered invoice entry. The community threads on a 2023 ChatGPT expense-bot experiment concern a different feature and do not concretely contradict the close capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the AI drives accruals and GL coding, explicit evidence that the close-specific automations are AI-based rather than rules-based, and independent or hands-on corroboration of faster closes.
